cases.title: Principal Product Designer - Market Data
cases.text: Job Description: About the Role: As Principal Product Designer - Market Data, you will own the design strategy for our Market Data platform—the real-time quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, and visualization systems that power how millions of people read and act on financial markets across The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor's Business Daily. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who sets direction across our financial brands and is the go-to design expert for how Dow Jones presents market data. Market Data connects across every one of our financial brands, and this role sets the design strategy that spans all of them. Your decisions will establish shared patterns—for quotes, charts, tables, portfolios, and alerts—that these brands build on. You will own the direction for how investors of every kind, from first-time savers to sophisticated professionals, interpret dense, fast-moving data and turn it into confident decisions, balancing the distinct needs of each brand against the consistency and quality users expect wherever they encounter our data. And this reach won't stop at the consumer. Market and pricing data runs across much of Dow Jones—so your influence will extend well beyond the consumer brands into our professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance to Dow Jones Energy, wherever market data underpins the experience. Where data meets the broader product, you will be the design lead who makes it cohere. This is a role of real influence and scope. You will shape strategy with senior leadership, resolve tension between individual brand priorities and platform consistency, define the market-data patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across the financial brands. You will be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others in your area build on. You will report to the VP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization. About the Team: Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva. Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise. You Will: Own the design strategy for the Market Data platform across our financial brands —setting a coherent, multi-year direction for quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, portfolios, and data visualization that spans The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and IBD, and connecting it to measurable outcomes like engagement, retention, and revenue Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your design direction for the Market Data platform to senior design, product, and business leaders—and to executives where the work warrants—building the partnerships that advance it across brands and making the case for how well-designed data experiences create competitive advantage Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain —developing new patterns, methods, and approaches for presenting complex financial information across multiple brands, and building a deep understanding of the problem space that lets you see opportunities ahead Shape the market-data patterns in our Index Design System . Establish the charting, data-table, real-time, and visualization standards that become the norm across the financial brands—knowing when consistency serves the user and when a brand's audience warrants a tailored approach—and help adjacent teams adopt and evolve them Extend your influence beyond our consumer brands into the wider portfolio —the professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Risk & Compliance to Newswires and OPIS, where market and pricing data is just as central—so the experiences built on our data share the same clarity, rigor, and craft. Be the design lead wherever data shapes the product Set a high bar for craft. Define what excellence looks like for dense, real-time financial information—typography, information density, motion, and the accessibility of complex tables and charts—and ensure consistent quality across the brands through design reviews and audits Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and subscription metrics, and help teams across the financial brands understand which measures matter for market-data experiences Mentor and grow senior designers across the financial brands , shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you cases.title: Principal Product Designer - Wall Street Journal Enterprise Products
cases.text: Job Description: About the Team: Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies. About Dow Jones Design & Research: Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year foundation while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our joint expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise. About the Role: We're seeking a Principal Product Designer to own the design strategy for our WSJ enterprise products—professional experiences that bring The Wall Street Journal and the wider Dow Jones portfolio to the businesses and institutions that rely on our journalism to make informed decisions. In this a senior individual-contributor role, you will set the direction for one of our growth areas and become a go-to design expert on how Dow Jones serves enterprise and professional customers. Enterprise customers don’t always consume content the way consumers do. Designing for them means thinking beyond the article—how a professional finds what's relevant to their work, how an organization manages access for its employees, and how our trusted journalism earns a place in the working day of decision-makers. You'll hold enterprise design to the high bar set by our consumer products and be tightly integrated with the platforms guaranteeing these decision-makers are empowered with WSJ + Dow Jones content. This is a role with influence and scope. You'll shape strategy with senior design, product, and business leadership, resolve the tension between enterprise requirements and consumer-grade craft, contribute to the enterprise patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across both our professional and consumer brands. You'll be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others build upon. You will report to the SVP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization. You Will: Own the design strategy for our enterprise experiences. Set a coherent, multi-year direction for how professional customers discover, read, and act on our journalism, and tie it to measurable outcomes such as seat growth, engagement, renewal, and expansion Own the admin experience that powers the reader experience. Design how organizations manage seats, assign content, and understand engagement across their teams Hold enterprise work to the Journal's standard of craft. Bring the typography, information design, and attention to detail that characterize our consumer products into a business environment, and help set the bar for what enterprise design quality means at Dow Jones Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your direction to senior design, product, and business leaders, and to other executives where needed, building the partnerships that move great design forward across a field of competing priorities Establish further patterns in our Index Design System—the components, density, navigation, and permission-aware behavior that professional products depend on—knowing when conformity with our consumer brands serves the user and when a professional audience warrants a different approach Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain. Professional workflows, AI-assisted features users must trust, and personalization that must earn its place are problems devoid of clear precedent. You'll create clarity where none exists and develop the approaches others adopt Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and revenue, and help teams understand which measures actually matter for a professional product Mentor and grow senior designers across our professional and consumer brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share You Have: 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or audiences Depth in both enterprise and consumer design. You've built products for professional users with real workflows and real constraints, and you hold that work to the standard of the best consumer experiences. This combination is the core requirement of the role. Experience designing professional platforms—workspaces, dashboards, personalized feeds, admin and permissions tooling A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or cases.title: Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition)
cases.text: Job Description: About the Role: As Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition), you will define the future of subscriber growth across Dow Jones' portfolio of brands, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily, and future subscription products. In this senior individual contributor role that operates at the intersection of design strategy, business strategy, and growth, you'll establish the long-term vision for how prospective customers discover, evaluate, and subscribe across our Commerce ecosystem - spanning registration, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing and packaging, checkout, identity, and experimentation. You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, Analytics, and executive leadership to solve highly ambiguous challenges and shape investment priorities that accelerate subscriber growth. Your work will define scalable Commerce patterns, influence our acquisition platform strategy, and connect design decisions to measurable business outcomes across multiple brands. Beyond delivering exceptional product experiences, you'll mentor senior designers, elevate design quality across Commerce, and establish standards that scale throughout the organization.You will report to the Director of Product Design, Commerce. About The Team: Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva. Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise. You Will: Define the long-term design strategy for subscriber growth across multiple Dow Jones brands. Lead highly ambiguous, business-critical initiatives spanning registration, identity, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing, packaging, checkout, and experimentation. Partner with senior leadership across Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to shape roadmap priorities and strategic investments. Create scalable acquisition patterns, frameworks, and interaction models that extend our Index Design System and can be reused across brands. Drive experimentation strategy by identifying high-impact opportunities throughout the acquisition funnel and translating insights into long-term product improvements. Translate customer research, behavioral data, market trends, and business goals into experiences that improve acquisition performance while maintaining a high bar for user experience. Lead strategic design explorations, vision work, and cross-functional workshops that align teams around future Commerce investments. Mentor junior and mid-level designers through design reviews, coaching, and thoughtful feedback that elevates craft across the organization. Influence how Commerce measures success by defining experience quality metrics alongside conversion, acquisition, and revenue KPIs. Represent Commerce Design within the broader Design & Research organization while contributing to company-wide design strategy and thought leadership. You Have: 10+ years of product design experience leading complex digital products. Portfolio demonstrating systems thinking, product vision, and measurable business impact. Experience leading highly ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives. Exceptional interaction, visual, systems, and service design skills. Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across disciplines. Experience defining design systems, reusable frameworks, and scalable product patterns. Outstanding communication and storytelling skills. Expert proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows. Deep understanding of accessibility and inclusive design. Experience mentoring senior designers and raising design quality across organizations. Nice to Have: Experience designing subscription acquisition, paywalls, registration, or checkout experiences. Experience partnering closely with Marketing or Growth organizations. Familiarity with pricing strategy, packaging, promotional offers, or experimentation platforms. Background in media, publishing, or consumer subscription businesses. Experience working across globally distributed organizations. cases.title: Social & Marketing Video Producer - Storyful
cases.text: Job Description: TITLE: Social & Marketing Video Producer LOCATION: Midtown Manhattan 3 days per week COMPENSATION: $70,000 - $80,000 + 5% Bonus About Us Storyful is a news and intelligence agency, now part of Dow Jones. Founded in 2010, the News & Content business sources, verifies and distributes user-generated content, breaking-news footage, and viral videos to news outlets, broadcasters and media organizations. Content is available to download through Newswire by Storyful, the world’s first social media newswire. Storyful Intelligence helps partners understand the attitudes, behaviors, and emotions shaping the world. Our mission is to provide intelligence-driven marketing and communications strategies to business leaders by delving into the nuances of social and digital media intelligence. Storyful’s direct-to-consumer social properties have millions of subscribers and followers, generating millions of views each month. Storyful is focused on building social audiences, monetizing clips, and the development of new formats and opportunities with platform partners, including YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and Twitter, while also leveraging video content to support marketing, brand, and commercial objectives across the business. About the Role Reporting to the VP, Marketing & Growth, you will be responsible for owning the development of compelling video formats, series, and content outputs to bring the Storyful brand to life across Storyful-owned channels as well as marketing and commercial touch points. Always thinking about new and creative ways to improve video and visual storytelling to drive engagement and impact across both consumer and professional audiences, you will collaborate with stakeholders from across the company to create high-performing social-first content and marketing video assets. You will proactively enhance relationships with platforms, content creators, communities, and other partners that can help us identify creative opportunities that push our brand in new, exciting directions and support audience growth, brand visibility, and monetization opportunities. This person should have proven experience creating and leveraging original content to drive measurable engagement and performance across multiple digital channels. Understanding that different audiences on different platforms will require different approaches, you will experiment to identify the most effective formats and engaging approaches for various channels and evolve those formats based on performance insights and business priorities. This position will be based in New York City and in office on a hybrid schedule. You Will Oversee and create video content, from start to finish, for social, marketing and owned channels - owning the full lifecycle from concept through to distribution and performance optimization. Lead production and editing of marketing video content — including talk-to-camera pieces, explainer videos, and promotional reels — optimized for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Identify new video content opportunities, based on relevant cultural or audience insights, current events, and social trends, and translate these into repeatable, scalable content format that can support both audience growth and marketing objectives . Create innovative graphics, visuals, and other video content forms to create engaging editorial and marketing materials for our Storyful owned channels and projects. Work directly with key members of the social and marketing team to complete timely tasks and projects, as well as work cross functionally between other departments to create valued content that aligns with audience, brand, and commercial objectives. Leverage Storyful’s Newswire assets and Intelligence outputs to identify, curate, and transform high-potential content into engaging, platform-native video formats for distribution across social and marketing channels. Use industry-standard editing and production tools to rapidly create and iterate content based on performance data and audience insights. Define and optimize against key performance metrics including watch time, retention, engagement, and audience growth. You Have 5+ years experience in video production and content creation with a strong focus on social and digital platforms (experience across both audience growth and/or marketing contexts is a plus) Video expertise and an understanding of the social media landscape as a whole, each platform's various nuances, and the latest in social trends An understanding of how content can be adapted for different audience types and objectives Fluency with social media platforms, marketing tools, and digital media insights Video production and gifted storytelling skills with the understanding of the power of video content across both social and marketing contexts Proficiency using Adobe Premiere and other editing platforms (CapCut, DaVinci Resolve) to produce and cut social-first video content Hands-on experience directing and producing on-camera talent, including shoot setup, teleprompter use, and basic lighting for studio or office environments Demonstrated ability to create content that delivers measurable performance — whether in audience growth, engagement, or marketing impact Graphics creation proficiency Initiative with a bias toward action and the ability to take ownership A strong communicator and cross-functional collaborator Strong organization, time and project management skills Ability to work under and meet tight deadlines Equal Opportunity Employer All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. cases.title: Associate, Corporate Communications
cases.text: Job Description: About Us: Dow Jones is a global provider of business news and information, delivering trusted news, data and analysis to consumers and organizations around the world. For more than 135 years Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality journalism and today has one of the largest news-gathering operations globally. It is home to award-winning publications including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Investor’s Business Daily, Financial News, Mansion Global and Private Equity News. The company’s business intelligence portfolio of Factiva, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Dow Jones Newswires and OPIS provides high-quality news, information and cutting-edge solutions to empower professional decision-making. Through its marquee events and exclusive executive memberships, the company convenes leaders that are shaping the future of business. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV). About the Role: Dow Jones is on a mission to provide the world’s most trusted journalism, data and analysis to help people make decisions. As part of the company’s global communications team, the Corporate Communications Associate plays a key role in delivering a strategic, comprehensive communications playbook that leverages executive voices and key milestones to support the Dow Jones narrative and drive brand authority. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Communications, this role is responsible for assisting with the day-to-day execution of external communication strategies that support the entire Dow Jones ecosystem across business lines including News, Energy, Risk, Enterprise and Consumer, while gaining valuable hands-on experience and a front-row seat to all aspects of the profession. The ideal candidate will possess prior industry internship experience and a strong desire to contribute to a team that is high-performing, creative, collaborative, curious and kind. Exceptional organizational skills, the ability to pivot quickly, a sharp attention to detail and a genuine passion for daily learning are essential. cases.title: Director of Editorial Design
cases.text: Job Description: Director of Editorial Design (MarketWatch) The Opportunity MarketWatch is seeking a Director of Editorial Design to lead the visual expression of our journalism. This is a newsroom leadership role responsible for helping readers better understand money, markets and the economy through compelling design, thoughtful presentation and innovative storytelling. Working closely with the Editor in Chief and newsroom leaders, the Director of Editorial Design will influence everything from homepage presentation and newsletter design to social storytelling, enterprise projects and emerging editorial products. The ideal candidate combines exceptional visual judgment with strong editorial instincts, audience awareness and a passion for digital journalism. They are energized by building systems, elevating storytelling and helping a newsroom evolve. This role is based in New York. Other locations will be considered based on merit. Responsibilities Serve as MarketWatch’s senior visual leader, helping shape presentation strategy and editorial expression across platforms. Shape and evolve a cohesive visual identity for MarketWatch across the website, newsletters, social channels and other reader-facing products. Partner closely with the Editor in Chief and newsroom and support and development teams on major editorial initiatives, enterprise projects and reader-experience priorities. Lead visual strategy for homepage presentation, story packaging, recurring franchises and major news moments. Establish and maintain design standards that improve clarity, consistency and reader engagement. Work across editorial, product, audience, newsletter, social, video and marketing teams to create a cohesive reader experience. Help identify opportunities where presentation, design and visual storytelling can strengthen journalism and improve reader understanding. Oversee visual contributors, freelancers, illustrators and creative partners as well as managing budgets for creatives. Manage and mentor staff, including a Data & Visuals Journalist and future visual storytelling hires. Champion experimentation with emerging storytelling formats, technologies and workflows—including the thoughtful application of AI-enabled tools—to improve how MarketWatch journalism is presented and consumed. Ensure all visual work meets the highest editorial, ethical and journalistic standards. What Success Looks Like In the first 12 to 24 months, the Director of Editorial Design will: Establish a more distinctive and recognizable visual identity for MarketWatch.
